abstract.para: In today's world, understanding environmental data and making informed decisions based on it is crucial for addressing complex environmental challenges. Yale School of the Environment's Environmental Data Science in R: Introduction to Data Integration and Machine Learning (ENV 730) course serves as an introduction to the integration of environmental data using R programming language, coupled with machine learning techniques. This dataset contains a zip file with all the data files used in this course, along with a README that has the metadata for those files.

description.para: Tabular site data have been downloaded from FLUXNET. A global elevation raster GeoTIFF was acquired from WorldClim. NDVI and EVI data for all FLUXNET sites were acquired from MODIS. A global raster GeoTIFF containing precipitation, minimum temperature, maximum temperature, and mean annual temperature layers was acquired from TerraClimate. A global raster GeoTIFF containing soil bulk density, pH level, and total nitrogen layers was acquired from SoilGrids. A raster GeoTIFF containing vegetation layers for the state of Connecticut was acquired from MODIS.
All RDATA files have been created with the R programming language.
